new: A 65.0 g piece of iron at 99.2 °C is dropped into 45.0 g of water at 21.0 °C in a calorimeter. Both end at 31.5 °C. What is q for the iron, the heat it gained or lost? (c for water = 4.184 J/(g·°C))
why: Stem asks for heat released (a positive amount) while the key is the signed q_iron = -1.98e3 J; asking for q removes the sign ambiguity.
